title: fix: compare admin and GPU register tokens in constant time
author: notsointresting

gist.summary: Added a shared `secretEquals` helper that hashes secrets with SHA-256 before comparing them in constant time. Enter admin routes now use it for `PLN_ENTER_TOKEN`, gen’s `/register` handler uses it for `PLN_GPU_TOKEN`, and Stripe’s duplicate helper was removed.
